Product

Code analysis with context

CodeScene's powerful features go beyond traditional code analysis. Visualize and evaluate all the factors that influence software delivery and quality, not just the code itself. Make informed, data-driven decisions based on CodeScene’s actionable insights and recommendations.

Pricing
Try for free
Discover actionable insights to improve your code's coverage. Learn more ->.

Code quality

Understand the quality of your code

CodeScene's features for code quality includes Code Health, a calculated value developed by CodeScene that is the only code-level metric with proven business impact. Understand how multiple factors, such as code complexity, code smells, and risk probability, impact your code quality and maintainability.

Read more
See it in action

Team dynamics

Run code analysis with behavioral context

No developer exists in a vacuum. Understand the behavioral aspects of your code base through visualizations of team dynamics as they relate to your files and system architecture. Understand knowledge distribution, simulate bus factor, and identify coordination needs.

See all team dynamics features
See it in action

Software delivery

Get better delivery insights

Software delivery is impacted by many factors - drill down into unplanned work, branch analysis, cost metrics and more to truly understand what is impacting the speed of delivery. Get insights that help you understand how you can deliver quality code faster.

See all software delivery features
See it in action

CodeScene ACE

Fix complex code with AI

Imagine a world where code gets better as you work on it. That’s the purpose of CodeScene ACE.

While other AI tools focus on code generation, CodeScene ACE helps you with some of the hardest parts of software development: maintaining and improving existing code.

Learn more about AI coding

Features

Integrations

CodeScene's features are built to integrate into your existing development workflow further enabling your CI/CD pipeline.

Learn more
Get started for free
Costs & issues trackers

Integrate to Jira, Trello, Azure DevOps or GitHub Issues and more. Measure accumulated costs per hotspot and sub-system to make better decision about resource allocation

Plugin System

Augment your data inside CodeScene further with third party code analysis views to create one source of truth, putting static analysis details into the context of our prioritized actionable hotspots

REST API

Use CodeScene insights with any tool you use. Programatically create and configure projects, or integrate CodeScene into your in-house development process and analytics tools
